notes: Reached GB storefront via the Akamai interstitial proof-of-work solver (same method as the prior Home-Decor pass: curl_cffi chrome-impersonation session, POST /_sec/verify?provider=interstitial). Checked: (1) the full mega-menu tree embedded as JSON in the homepage's serverApp-state, (2) robots.txt (no Claude-named disallow), (3) the site's own GB category sitemap (https://www.zarahome.com/8/info/sitemaps/sitemap-home-categories-zh-gb-0.xml.gz, 322 URLs total). No standalone Bestsellers PLP exists anywhere on the GB storefront. The menu-tree JSON contains multiple entries with canonicalName/name = 'BESTSELLERS' (keys E-I-A_D_BESTSELLERS_DORMITORIO / bedroom, E-I-A_S_BESTSELLERS_SALON / home-decor, E-I-A_MUEBLES_BESTSELLERS_MUEBLES / furniture, E-I-A_M_BESTSELLERS_COMEDOR / kitchen-dining, E-I-A_B_BESTSELLERS_BANO / bathroom, E-I-A_F_BESTSELLERS_COSMETICA / fragrances, E-I-K_K_BESTSELLERS_KIDS / kids), but every one resolves through its seo.seoId to the exact same URL as its parent department's general landing page, distinguished only by a '?celement=<id>' query param, e.g. /gb/bedroom-n944?celement=1020462432, /gb/kitchen-dining-n1012?celement=1020462433, /gb/bathroom-n1050?celement=1020461936, /gb/fragrances-n1057?celement=1020462434, /gb/kids-n1094?celement=1020461937, /gb/home-decor-n989?celement=1020461935. celement addresses an in-page curated 'grid'-type content widget/section embedded partway down each department's ordinary category page -- not a separate filterable listing with its own URL or product count. None of these celement targets, nor any /best-sellers, /bestsellers, /top-sellers, /popular, /customer-favourites style path, appears as a standalone entry in the GB sitemap (confirmed by full-text scan of all 322 sitemap URLs for 'bestsell'/'popular'/'trend'/'top-sell' -- zero hits besides the widget URLs already excluded). This matches the brief's exclusion for pages that merely reference a bestselling concept as a marketing widget rather than being a genuine Bestsellers PLP in their own right. Concluding no genuine Bestsellers PLP exists on Zara Home GB.
